data.description:
## Context / Problem
`_pai_structured` manually creates fresh Agent runs for prompted-output recovery, so output attempts can reset the request budget and retry history is assembled outside Pydantic (`src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py:87-178`). The approved RP-01 contract instead uses the Pydantic output-policy adapter [rebar:grazeable-preferred-bumblebee] in one Agent operation while preserving every authoritative input and stored response.

## Approach
Replace the manual structured-output attempt scheduler with one Pydantic `Agent` run using the approved output retry allowance and a single derived `UsageLimits.request_limit` equal to the existing base allowance plus that output allowance. Add a focused `src/rebar/llm/pai_retry.py` helper because `runner.py` is already 797 lines. Its documented model-request wrapper copies the wire context without mutating Agent state: include the complete failed `ModelResponse` only when every viable candidate has a known context window and Pydantic token count proving `input_tokens + effective_max_tokens <= window`; otherwise omit that response whole. Reject `length`/`max_tokens` before parsing and spend one output retry with the exact approved concision guidance. Refusal/content-filter remains terminal. Unknown counts select omission, and authoritative input that still cannot fit fails closed without truncation.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/llm/pai_retry.py` — new fit decision, non-mutating wire projection, and output-size retry guidance.
- `src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py` — replace manual attempt scheduling with one Agent operation.
- `src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py` — derive the combined operation-wide request allowance without resetting counters.
- `src/rebar/llm/runner.py` — compose the helper without growing past the 800-line cap.
- `tests/unit/test_structured_run.py`, `tests/unit/test_runner_pydantic_budget.py`, `tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py` — operation, history, and limit contracts.

## Testing
- Happy path: invalid then valid output succeeds in two Agent requests with one operation result.
- Boundary matrix: complete response fits, complete response does not fit, token count is unavailable, and authoritative input itself cannot fit.
- Limit matrix: tool turn plus output retry succeeds at the derived allowance and fails one below it; repeated output-size failure exhausts the bounded allowance.
- Terminal matrix: refusal/content-filter performs one call; output-size retry never triggers provider fallback.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Invalid-then-valid structured output completes through one Pydantic Agent run and reports two Pydantic requests under one shared `UsageLimits`; verified by focused real-`FunctionModel` tests.
- [ ] A complete 5,000-character failed response is present on the retry wire only when the full request plus output reserve fits; otherwise zero characters from that response are present, while `result.all_messages()` retains all 5,000; verified by complete and omit tests.
- [ ] Unknown count/window chooses whole-response omission, and an authoritative-input overflow raises the typed fit/context failure without shortening system, user, or tool content; verified by failure-path tests.
- [ ] `length`/`max_tokens` consumes at most the configured output retries and sends exactly “Make your response as concise as possible while fulfilling the prompt and output format requirements.”; verified by success and exhaustion cases.
- [ ] Refusal/content-filter remains terminal after one model call and does not activate output retry or provider fallback; verified by call-count and candidate assertions.
- [ ] The combined request allowance is documented as raiseable through a normal reviewed follow-up if legitimate recovery is starved; no per-attempt reset path remains in the new scheduler, verified by source census and budget tests.
data.title: RP-01 S2 — Run structured-output recovery as one bounded Agent operation
